plain: To win out and gain the upper hand; also to be the most common

webster.text: To overcome; to gain the victory or superiority; to gain the advantage.

example.quote: This error however at length prevailed, the earth become a globe, and Descrates declared it was whirled round its axis by a vortex.
example.cite: Thomas Jefferson, Notes on the State of Virginia, Query XVII (Religion) (1802 ed.)
